# Boiler Service 2024

## Summary

Annual service on 12 October 2024, booked with the same firm that fitted the unit about six years ago. The engineer spent around an hour on site, ran the flue gas analyser, checked the case seals and cleaned the condensate trap before signing the benchmark sheet. The reminder card went straight back inside the door.

## Findings

The expansion vessel pressure was low at 0.6 bar, well under the 1.0 bar the manual asks for, which explained the pressure gauge dropping whenever the system cooled. Flame picture and combustion looked clean at the analyser. The magnetic filter had a thin layer of black sludge, so it was cleaned and refitted. No leaks at the pump or the pressure relief pipe. The condensate trap was clear but had a little grit in the bottom, so it was flushed and refitted.

## Actions

Refilled the expansion vessel to 1.2 bar and topped the sealed system to match. Recharged the filter, replaced a perished case seal at the burner, and left the service record in the folder. I was told to bleed the bedroom radiator once the heating came back on. Next visit booked for the following autumn.
